The bubbles float slowly upward with gentle distortions, while shafts of light penetrate from above, creating a dappled pattern across the canvas. The color palette emphasizes blues and greens to evoke an aquatic atmosphere, with subtle ripples and highlights adding to the realism of the submerged view.
